title: Plumeform glass card grid band
description: A near-black green band with a centred (or left) eyebrow, bold title and body, an optional paper pill with a note beside it, then a three-column grid of glass cards: a mint line icon or mint eyebrow, a bold title with an optional tier tag, and soft grey text. Heading and cards rise in with a blur, staggered across each row.
notes: backdrop is a slot for the original's WebGL art; empty shows a soft glow
name: plumeform-card-grid

props.name: align
props.description: centre the heading (and button row) or keep it on the left

props.name: cta
props.description: a pill button under the heading

props.name: ctaNote
props.description: a short line beside the button (under it on phones)

props.name: cards
props.description: the glass cards, three to a row on desktop

props.name: backdrop
props.description: art behind the band (the original's WebGL fluted glass); empty shows a soft glow
